response.reading_text: The city's public transportation system has undergone significant changes in recent years. One of the most notable developments is the introduction of a new bus rapid transit (BRT) system, which has improved connectivity between different parts of the city. According to a study by the Urban Transport Authority, the BRT system has reduced travel times by up to 30% and increased passenger numbers by over 20%. However, some critics argue that the new system has led to increased traffic congestion in certain areas, as drivers are more likely to use their cars instead of public transport. Others have pointed out that the BRT system does not serve all parts of the city equally, with some neighborhoods still lacking adequate access to reliable and efficient transportation options.

questions.question: What is one of the main benefits of the new bus rapid transit (BRT) system in the city?
options: Increased passenger numbers by up to 50%
Improved connectivity between different parts of the city
questions.answer: Improved connectivity between different parts of the city

questions.question: According to the Urban Transport Authority, what percentage increase in passenger numbers has been observed as a result of the BRT system?
What is one potential drawback of the new BRT system, according to some critics?
options: Increased traffic congestion in certain areas
Reduced travel times by up to 50%
Decreased air quality due to increased emissions
questions.answer: Increased traffic congestion in certain areas

questions.question: What does the author imply about the BRT system's coverage of different neighborhoods?
options: It serves all parts of the city equally
Some neighborhoods still lack adequate access to reliable and efficient transportation options
It has improved connectivity between all neighborhoods
questions.answer: Some neighborhoods still lack adequate access to reliable and efficient transportation options

questions.question: What can be inferred about the author's attitude towards the BRT system?
options: They have mixed feelings about its effectiveness
They are critical of its limitations
questions.answer: They have mixed feelings about its effectiveness
